reasoning: A classic rectangular speech bubble with three lines of text inside, universally understood as a text message, chat, or written comment. It is an ideal fit for common everyday tasks like texting someone back, replying in group chats, or commenting on documents, though it shares visual overlap with other speech bubble icons.
